basic_details.job_title: CARI Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Central Ayurveda Research Institute (CARI), Bengaluru, under the Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences, Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, will hold a Walk-in Interview/Written Test at 10 am on 18 November 2026 (Wednesday). The venue is the Institute at #12, Uttarahalli Manavarthe Kaval, Kanakapura Main Road, Thalaghattapura post, Bengaluru-560109. Under Advertisement No. 03/2026-27, dated 04.11.2026, CARI Bengaluru will engage two Senior Research Fellow (Ayurveda) and one Senior Research Fellow (IT) on contractual basis, each at Rs. 42,000/- + 30% HRA per month.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee.

content_sections.heading: About CARI Bengaluru
content_sections.text: Central Ayurveda Research Institute, Bengaluru, is a Government of India institute under the Ministry of Ayush and the Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences (CCRAS). Its letterhead describes it as a Centre of Excellence awarded by the Ministry of Ayush. The Senior Research Fellows will be engaged co-terminus with the Institute's Project/Programme.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Essential: BAMS from recognized University. Desirable: Yoga certification with practical experience in Yoga in a reputed Yoga Institute/Hospital. Desirable: Computer Knowledge. Desirable: Higher qualification/experience in Research projects. Age: Maximum age should not exceed 35 years on the date of Walk-In-Interview. Essential: BE/B.Tech/MCA from a recognized University, preferably Computer science/Information technology. Desirable: Experience in Digital platform and website management. Age: Maximum age should not exceed 35 years on the date of Walk-In-Interview. Age will be determined as on the date of the Written Test/Interview. The age limit is relaxable in the case of SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates as per Government of India rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post. Both Senior Research Fellow posts carry a remuneration of Rs. 42,000/- per month plus 30% HRA per month. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

rows.essential_qualification: BE/B.Tech/MCA from a recognized University, preferably Computer science/Information technology.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application form may be downloaded from www.cari.gov.in or www.ccras.nic.in , or collected personally from the CARI, Bengaluru office on working days between 10 am and 04 pm. Candidates must bring: The duly filled application form A set of self-attested photocopies of certificates, marks cards, caste certificate and experience certificates etc. The original certificates 2 recent passport size photographs

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The Walk-in Interview/Written Test starts at 10 am on 18 November 2026 at the Institute. The Selection Committee has the right to select or reject the application of a candidate. Personnel selected through this interview may also be deployed in other projects of the Institute as per requirement.

faq.question: Q1. When is the CARI Bengaluru SRF walk-in interview in 2026?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview/Written Test is on 18 November 2026 (Wednesday) at 10 am.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the CARI Bengaluru walk-in held?
faq.answer: It is held at Central Ayurveda Research Institute, #12, Uttarahalli Manavarthe Kaval, Kanakapura Main Road, Thalaghattapura post, Bengaluru-560109.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in CARI Bengaluru Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 for Senior Research Fellow (Ayurveda) and 1 for Senior Research Fellow (IT).

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the CARI Bengaluru SRF posts?
faq.answer: Senior Research Fellow (Ayurveda) needs BAMS from a recognized University. Senior Research Fellow (IT) needs BE/B.Tech/MCA from a recognized University, preferably Computer science/Information technology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CARI Bengaluru SRF posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age should not exceed 35 years on the date of the Walk-In-Interview, relaxable for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Senior Research Fellow at CARI Bengaluru?
faq.answer: Both posts carry Rs. 42,000/- per month plus 30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 42,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes, 30% HRA per month is paid in addition to Rs. 42,000/-. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the CARI Bengaluru walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the duly filled application, a set of self-attested photocopies of certificates, marks cards, caste certificate and experience certificates, the originals, and 2 recent passport size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Walk-in Interview/Written Test on 18 November 2026, and the Selection Committee has the right to select or reject an application.

faq.question: Q10. Is the CARI Bengaluru SRF job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual and co-terminus with the Project/Programme, initially for six months, which may be curtailed or extended.
